blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence.
To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers.
Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA .
blocks.zh:
智能车辆中的强能感知需要3D物体探测器,在域位移下,如日出时间,位置,或天气的变化,这些探测器仍然可以依赖. 然而,由于成本高昂的注释和罕见的转移,一些环境缺乏足够的数据来训练独立的探测器. 联邦学习为协作模式培训提供了一个保护隐私的框架,使客户能够受益于不同环境中的共享学习。 然而,这一框架传统上依赖单一的全球共识模式,这种模式在不同的当地数据分布方面难以做到。 本地条件通过调整模型的一个子集得到更好的捕捉,但是许多个性化方法依赖于预先定义的层分或固定个性化比率,从而限制了适应客户特有的差异.
为了减少这种僵硬性,我们提议FedCKA, 一个基于核心核心的克内尔对接(CKA)策略, 动态地处理个性化-全球化的取舍。 具体来说,FedCKA在培训期间计算出本地客户模式与全球共识模式之间的分层特征相似. FedCKA通过将分层相近分数转换为客户特有聚合口罩,有选择地分享代表-相符合的分层.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
3D Object Detection (3D-OD) is central to robotic perception in Intelligent Vehicles (IV), providing object poses and dimensions needed for planning and safe navigation.
However, domain shifts across vehicles, times of day, weather, and locations substantially degrade 3D detection performance [ 1 ] (see Fig. 1 ).
Because labeled data in niche or edge-case domains can be too scarce to support robust standalone training, a collaborative framework is desirable.
Yet, for IV applications, centrally collecting multimodal sensor data is constrained by privacy barriers and massive data volumes [ 2 ] , while naive localized retraining remains computationally expensive [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
3D对象检测(3D-OD)在智能车辆(IV)中是机器人感知的核心,提供了规划和安全导航所需的物体外观和维度.
然而,域名在车辆、白天、天气和地点之间的移动会大大地降低3D探测性能[1](见图一)。
由于在特殊领域或边缘领域贴上标签的数据可能太少,无法支持强有力的独立培训,因此需要一个合作框架。
然而,对于IV应用,集中收集多式传感器数据受到隐私障碍和大量数据卷[2]的限制,而天真的局部再培训在计算上仍然昂贵[3]。

blocks.en:
These constraints motivate Federated Learning (FL), which enables privacy-preserving collaborative training for multi-domain adaptation without data centralization [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , by sharing only model updates. However, real-world deployment across heterogeneous data distributions introduces a central personalization-globalization trade-off: which model components should be globally shared versus locally personalized? Many personalization methods resolve this trade-off through static layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, which may fail to capture client- and layer-wise representation divergence.
For multi-modal 3D-OD, this rigidity is particularly problematic because domain shifts can affect sensor backbones and fusion modules asymmetrically [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
这些限制激励了联邦学习(FL),它通过只分享模型更新,为多领域适应提供隐私保护合作培训,而无需数据集中[4,5,6]. 然而,现实世界在不同数据分布方面的部署引入了核心个性化-全球化取舍:哪些模式组成部分应当在全球共享,而哪些模式应当在当地实现个性化? 许多个性化方法通过静地分层或固定个性化比率来解决这种取舍,这可能无法捕捉到客户端和分层的表示差异.
对于多式3D-OD,这种刚性尤其有问题,因为域位移可以不对称地影响传感器骨干和聚变模块 [7].

blocks.en:
Despite this need, FL for multimodal 3D-OD remains underexplored. While prior federated detection and, more recently, federated 3D-OD studies exist, they do not systematically isolate location-, weather-, and illumination-induced client heterogeneity.
This limits insight into whether personalization helps under these structured client-level domain shifts.
While recent federated 3D detection approaches, including FedM2Former [ 9 ] and FedPillarNet [ 10 ] , address client heterogeneity through personalized learning, they do not systematically isolate location-, weather-, and illumination-induced domains or compare representative FL personalization strategies within a unified 3D-OD benchmark.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这种需要,但3D-OD多式联运的FL仍然没有得到充分利用。 虽然以前有联邦检测,最近也有联邦3D-OD研究,但它们并没有系统地隔离地点、天气和照明引起的客户异质性。
这限制了对个性化在这些结构化客户端域转移下是否有帮助的洞察.
虽然最近联通了3D检测方法,包括FedM2Former [9]和FedPillarNet [10],通过个性化学习解决客户端异质性问题,但是它们并没有系统地隔离位置,天气,和发光引起的域,也没有在一个统一的3D-OD基准范围内比较有代表性的FL个性化战略.

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we study how federated 3D-OD methods handle location-, weather-, and illumination-induced client heterogeneity, and whether representation consistency can determine which layers should be globally aggregated or locally personalized.
We isolate client-data heterogeneity by focusing on labeled, client-level domain adaptation across location, weather, and illumination, leaving system-level constraints such as client reliability and sensor-configuration variability to future work.
We make the following contributions:
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们研究了联邦3D-OD方法如何处理定位、天气和发光引起的客户异质性,以及代表一致性是否能够决定哪些层次应当在全球汇总或在当地个性化。
我们把客户端-数据异质性隔离开来,注重标注的,客户端层面的域名在位置,天气,发光等方面的适应性,将客户端可靠性和传感器配置可变性等系统层面的制约留给了未来工作.
我们作出以下贡献:

blocks.en: 1. Establish a unified multi-domain federated 3D object detection benchmark based on explicit location-, weather-, and illumination-induced client heterogeneity, enabling controlled evaluation under realistic domain shifts. 2. Introduce FedCKA, a dynamic CKA-based layer masking strategy that uses layer-wise representation similarity to determine which model components should be globally aggregated versus locally personalized. 3. Demonstrate that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest competitor by identifying domain-sensitive layers.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
3D Object Detection methods are commonly categorized by sensor modality: camera, LiDAR, or multimodal [ 11 ] .
While multimodal methods typically fuse LiDAR and camera data via Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) representations [ 12 ] , they struggle across varying domains like day, night, and adverse weather [ 13 ] .
This limitation motivates methods that can exploit multi-domain data, particularly when such data are distributed across clients and cannot be centrally pooled.
blocks.zh:
三维 物体探测方法通常按传感器方式分类:相机,LiDAR,或多式 [11].
虽然多式联运方法通常通过Bird-Eye-View(BEV)的表示来将LiDAR和相机数据融合在一起[12],但它们在白天、夜晚和恶劣天气等不同领域挣扎 [13]。
这一限制促使采用能够利用多领域数据的方法,特别是当这些数据分布在客户之间,不能集中收集时。

blocks.en:
Federated Learning (FL) enables such collaborative training on decentralized data. It commonly operates under client data that is not independent and identically distributed (IID), not centrally shared, or not of equal size across clients [ 14 ] .
This statistical and system heterogeneity introduces challenges for convergence [ 5 ] and cross-domain generalization [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
联邦学习使这种关于分散数据的合作培训成为可能。 它通常在客户数据下运行,这种数据不独立且分布相同(IID),不统一共享,或客户之间大小不相等[14].
这种统计和系统差异性给趋同[5]和跨域通论[15]带来了挑战.

blocks.en: The foundational FedAvg [ 2 ] algorithm aggregates independent local updates via weighted averaging. While effective under IID conditions, its performance degrades significantly under heterogeneous data distributions [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 基础 FedAvg [2] 算法通过加权平均值汇总独立的本地更新. 其性能虽然在ID条件下有效,但在数据分布的差异下却会显著地下降[16].

blocks.en:
Data heterogeneity in FL fundamentally shapes what client models should share and how the server should aggregate their updates. Approaches to managing this heterogeneity span data preprocessing, training objectives, and aggregation schemes [ 14 ] .
For all of these, the main distinction is the objective: aligning all clients toward one domain-invariant model, or producing multiple domain-adapted models.
blocks.zh:
FL中的数据异质性从根本上塑造了哪些客户端模型应该共享,服务器应该如何集成其更新. 管理这种异质性的方法跨越数据处理、培训目标和汇总计划[14]。
对于所有这些,主要区别是目标:将所有客户端与一个域-变量模型相协调,或者产生多个域-适应模型.

blocks.en:
To learn a more domain-invariant global model, methods such as FedProx [ 5 ] , FedDyn [ 17 ] , and SCAFFOLD [ 6 ] reduce client drift during training.
Other approaches use task arithmetic [ 18 ] to align client update gradients and estimate a less conflicting global update direction [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
However, a single global model may be suboptimal under strong client heterogeneity, and these methods require problem-specific manual parameter tuning.
Personalized FL addresses this by adapting models to client-specific domains while retaining shared knowledge.
Common approaches keep batch normalization or other targeted layers client-specific, as in FedBN [ 4 ] and FedRep [ 22 ] .
Because these methods require manually predefined global and domain-specific layer partitions, this static approach can be suboptimal when domain specificity varies across layers or clients.
blocks.zh:
为了学习一个更具域-不变量的全球模型,FedProx [5],FedDyn [17]等方法,以及SCAFFOLD [6]在训练期间减少客户漂移.
其他方法使用任务算术 [18] 来调整客户端更新梯度并估计一个不太矛盾的全球更新方向 [19, 20, 21].
然而,在强客户端异质性下,单一的全球模型可能不尽人意,这些方法需要针对特定问题的人工参数调取.
个性化的FL通过在保留共享知识的同时根据客户特有领域调整模型来解决这个问题.
共同方法保持批量正常化或其他针对客户的层次,如FedBN[4]和FedRep[22].
由于这些方法需要手动预定义的全域和域特有地层分区,因此当域特异性因地层或客户端而异时,这种静态方法可能不尽人意.

blocks.en:
Recent work addresses this rigidity by using model updates to infer which parameters to mask for personalization.
FedSelect [ 23 ] assumes the largest parameter updates are the most domain-significant and personalizes them.
FedMC [ 24 ] uses the Fisher information derived from gradient magnitudes to identify the most sensitive parameters for personalization.
Although these methods avoid manual partitioning, they still rely on parameter-space importance by implicitly assuming that same-index parameters across clients correspond to comparable functional components, which may not hold [ 25 ] . To overcome the limitations of parameter-space comparisons and manual layer selection, this work selects personalized layers based on representational consistency across clients.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作通过使用模型更新来推断哪些参数可以掩盖个性化,来解决这种刚性.
FederalSelect [23] 假设最大的参数更新是最显著的域并实现个性化.
FedMC [24] 使用从梯度相等得到的Fisher信息来识别最敏感的个性化参数.
虽然这些方法避免了手动分割,但它们仍然依赖于参数-空间的重要性,暗中假设客户端的同指数参数对应可比较的功能元件,这些功能元件可能无法持有 [25]. 为了克服参数-空间比较和人工层选择的局限性,本作根据各客户端的表达一致性选择个性化层.

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en: III-A Motivation
blocks.zh: 三-A 动力

blocks.en:
FedCKA is motivated by the idea that layers should be shared across clients only when their representations remain consistent after local adaptation.
While existing federated methods rely on parameter-space distances [ 23 ] or gradient magnitudes [ 24 ] , this work argues that representational consistency is a more reliable proxy for transferability and uses it to determine which layers to personalize.
This strategy incorporates Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) [ 26 ] to measure how differently two layers map the same set of incoming features to their outgoing features.
This metric produces a normalized score bounded in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with 0 indicating strong dissimilarity and 1 indicating high similarity in the representation space transformation for each layer.
blocks.zh:
FedCKA的动机是,只有在客户的表述在当地适应后保持一致时,才能在客户之间分享层分.
虽然现有联想方法依赖于参数-相距[23]或梯度相距[24],但本作认为代表一致性是可转让性的更可靠的代名词并用它来决定哪些层来个性化.
该战略纳入了以内核对齐(CKA)[26],以衡量两层如何不同地将同一组接入的特征映射到其外出特征上。
这一度量法产生一个以 [0, 1] [0, 1] 为界的正态分数, 0 表示强烈的相差分数, 1 表示每一层的表示空间转换高度相似.

blocks.en:
By comparing layers at identical depths across the global and local models, FedCKA estimates whether each layer remains transferable.
The most dissimilar layers can then be personalized by masking them from the global model aggregation. This lets certain layers drift to domain-specific optima, while sharing representationally similar layers to transfer global knowledge.
Because only unmasked parameters are transmitted, FedCKA reduces shared parameter information by the fraction of masked parameters, improving bandwidth efficiency and potentially reducing information exposure.
blocks.zh:
FedCKA通过在全球和本地模型的相同深度对地层进行比较,估计每个地层是否仍然可转移。
最相异的地层可以通过遮掩它们从全球模型聚合中被个性化. 这使得某些地层漂移到特定域的optima上,同时共享相似的地层来传输全球知识.
由于只传输了未显示的参数,FedCKA将共享参数信息由被遮蔽的参数分出来减少,提高了带宽效率并有可能减少信息曝光.

blocks.en:
The first step is to estimate local divergence by computing the CKA score between the saved state of the previous global model, G t − 1 G_{t-1} , and the newly updated local model C ~ i , t \widetilde{C}_{i,t} .
Using G t − 1 G_{t-1} as a common reference ensures that each client’s layer-wise divergence is measured against the same pre-aggregation model state.
This computation uses a small random subset of the client’s local training data passed through both models without requiring ground-truth labels.
Based on the layers’ representational similarity, the client determines which layers to personalize and thus mask from global aggregation.
Consequently, each client sends its unmasked layers, alongside a lightweight binary mask identifying them, to the central server.

因此,每个客户端都向中央服务器发送其未蒙面的图层,同时发送轻量级二进制口罩以识别它们.

The server aggregates these shared parameters layer-by-layer to form the updated global model G t G_{t} .
Finally, each client updates C ~ i , t \widetilde{C}_{i,t} by injecting the unmasked parameters from G t G_{t} , yielding the updated client model C i , t C_{i,t} .
This process allows each client to personalize its most dissimilar layers while benefiting from the knowledge learned by other clients.

服务器将这些共享参数逐层汇总,形成更新的全球模型G t G_{t}.
最后,每个客户端通过从 Gt G_{t 中注入未显示的参数来更新 C ~ i, t\glasstilde{ C}_{i, t},生成更新的客户端模式 C i, t C_{i, t}.
这个过程可以让每个客户端在受益于其他客户所学到的知识的同时,将最相异的层个性化.

blocks.en: III-C Centered Kernel Alignment
blocks.zh: 三-C 核心内核对接

blocks.en:
Centered Kernel Alignment [ 26 ] is a similarity index between two layers, based on the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) [ 27 ] for comparing the representations induced by two layers.
Different layer parameterizations may yield similar representations, making direct comparison in parameter space misleading.
CKA addresses this limitation by comparing layer activations rather than parameters.
CKA has similarly been used in representation analysis of vision architectures for transformers and convolutional neural networks [ 28 ] .
In this work, this principle is used in FL, where CKA measures whether a locally trained client layer remains representationally aligned with the previous global model.
blocks.zh:
中心内核对接[26]是两层之间的类似指数,以希尔伯特-施密特独立标准(HSIC)[27]为基础来比较由两层诱导的表示.
不同的分层参数化可能会产生相近的表示,使参数空间的直接比较产生误导.
CKA通过比较地层活化而不是参数来解决这一局限性.
CKA同样也被用于变压器和进化神经网络视觉结构的表示分析 [28].
在这项工作中,FL采用这一原则,其中CKA衡量当地受过培训的客户层是否仍然与以前的全球模式保持一致。

blocks.en: IV Experiment Design
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设计

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: 四-A 数据集

blocks.en:
The experimental framework assigns each client to a distinct environmental domain. Table I defines these five domains (A-E), spanning Boston and Singapore across varying weather and lighting conditions.
This benchmark uses the nuScenes dataset, one of the most impactful datasets for onboard perception [ 29 ] , which distinguishes between time of day and weather.
The scenes, each consisting of roughly 40 annotated samples in a 20-second time window, are split such that each client acts as a distinct domain and possesses all data for that domain, as shown in Table I .
These clients exhibit heterogeneity not only in location, time of day, and weather, but also in scene count and class composition.
To illustrate, the Singapore training set contains, on average, three times as many annotated motorcycles, while Boston features more than twice as many cars.
Although domain E’s three validation scenes may yield noisy standalone metrics, their compounded domain shifts and the small training set provide a stress test for knowledge transfer at the edge of the federated system.

blocks.en: IV-B Detector
blocks.zh: 四-B探测器

blocks.en:
To isolate federated data heterogeneity from baseline detector instability, we employ the Cross-Modal Transformer (CMT).
CMT provides strong robustness via attention-based multimodal fusion [ 30 ] and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on synthetic corruption benchmarks [ 13 ] .
Across all experiments, detector configuration and hyperparameters remain constant to isolate the impact of federated strategies.
blocks.zh:
为了将联邦数据异质性与基线探测器的不稳定性隔离开来,我们采用了Cross-Modal变形器(CMT).
CMT通过基于关注的多式聚变[30]和超过合成腐败基准的最新方法提供强大的强力。
在所有实验中,探测器配置和超参数都保持不变,以隔离联合战略的影响。

blocks.en: IV-C Federated Strategies
blocks.zh: 联邦战略

blocks.en:
The benchmark compares strategies that either improve a shared global model or preserve client-specific parameters for personalization.
Globalization approaches include FedAvg [ 2 ] , FedDyn [ 17 ] to limit client drift, and PCGrad [ 19 ] to align client gradients.
Personalization baselines are divided into two categories. Layer-wise methods include FedBN [ 4 ] for personalized batch normalization and FedRep [ 22 ] for head personalization. Meanwhile, parameter-selection methods include FedSelect [ 23 ] to personalize the highest-updating parameters and FedMC [ 24 ] for the most influential parameters. All methods are run for 40 rounds with one local epoch.
blocks.zh:
该基准比较了改进共同全球模式或保留特定客户个性化参数的战略。
全球化方法包括FedAvg [2],FedDyn [17]限制客户漂移,PCGrad [19] 调整客户梯度.
个性化基线分为两类. 分层方法包括FedBN[4]用于个性化批量正常化和FedRep[22]用于头部个性化. 同时,参数选择方法包括FedSelect [23] 将更新最高的参数个性化,FedMC [24] 为最具影响力的参数. 所有方法都用于40个回合,一个地方时代。

blocks.en: IV-D Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en:
To contextualize the benchmark, we establish two reference points: isolated own-domain training (a client’s baseline without federated collaboration) and centralized training (the expected upper bound of the federated system).
These points contextualize the federated results, which are reported in mean Average Precision (mAP), nuScenes Detection Score (NDS), and Car Average Precision (CAP).
Given that domains C, D, and E lack 1, 3, and 6 of the 10 target classes, respectively, mAP and NDS may be skewed.
The mAP and NDS are computed only over classes or attributes that are available in the validation domains.
Consequently, to provide a stable, high-volume single-class comparison, we report CAP, which is the mean over the four nuScenes distance thresholds.
Finally, to account for the imbalance in validation scene counts across domains, all reported averages are weighted by the number of validation scenes.
blocks.zh:
为了根据具体情况制定基准,我们建立了两个参考点:孤立的自有领域培训(一个没有联邦协作的客户基线)和集中培训(联邦制度的预期上限)。
这些要点使联邦结果具有内在性,这些结果以平均精度(mAP)、nuScens检测分数(NDS)和汽车平均精度(CAP)报告。
鉴于在10个目标类别中,C、D和E领域分别缺乏1、3和6, mAP和NDS可能存在偏差。
mAP和NDS只根据验证域中可用的类或属性来计算.
因此,为了提供稳定、高容量的单级比较,我们报告CAP,这是四个nuScens距离阈值的平均值。
最后,为了考虑到不同领域的验证场景计数的不平衡,所有报告的平均值都以验证场景的数量加权.

blocks.en: V-A Globalization versus Personalization
blocks.zh: V-A 全球化与个性化

blocks.en: Traditional globalization methods do not produce a consensus model that rivals centralized performance. Static-layer personalization strategies, FedBN and FedRep, which personalize the batch normalization (BN) layers or the head of each client, perform comparably to globalization methods. However, even with this targeted adaptation, these models fall short. These BN and head layers may not have sufficient power to move the client models towards their local optima, as they have fewer personal parameters than the parameter-level personalization strategies and do not influence the crucial intermediate cross-modal merging stages.
blocks.zh: 传统的全球化方法不能产生一种与集中业绩相竞争的共识模式。 静态层个性化战略,即FedBN和FedRep,将批量正常化(BN)层或每个客户的负责人个性化,与全球化方法相仿。 然而,即使有了这种有针对性的适应,这些模式仍然不足。 这些BN和头层可能没有足够的力量将客户端模型向本地的opima移动,因为它们的个人参数比参数级个性化策略要少,并且不会影响关键的中间跨模式合并阶段.

blocks.en:
Among the established baselines, the parameter-level personalization strategies of FedSelect and FedMC achieve the highest performance.
However, the proposed FedCKA method achieves the highest performance across the three metrics (mAP, NDS, CAP), suggesting that adaptive layer-wise personalization better accommodates domain discrepancies than fixed or parameter-magnitude-based personalization.
blocks.zh:
在既定的基线中,FedSelect和FedMC的参数级个性化战略取得了最高的性能.
然而,拟议的FedCKA方法实现了三个度量标准(mAP,NDS,CAP)的最高性能,表明适应层的个性化比固定或参数放大的个性化更能适应域差异.

blocks.en: Ultimately, the difficulty of achieving a global consensus model across these clients highlights the severity of the domain gap. Because globalization forces different domains toward a single shared optimum, the resulting model remains suboptimal. Conversely, the success of the parameter-level baselines and FedCKA demonstrates that, by allowing a sufficiently large or important group of parameters to adapt to a domain, client models can move closer to their local optima.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,在这些客户之间达成全球共识模式的困难突出了域间差距的严重性。 由于全球化迫使不同领域实现一个共同的最佳模式,由此产生的模式仍然不够理想。 相反,参数级基线和FedCKA的成功表明,通过允许足够大或重要的一组参数来适应一个域,客户端模型可以更接近其本地的opitima.

blocks.en: V-B Cross-Domain Generalization
blocks.zh: V-B 跨领域通用

blocks.en:
Cross-domain generalization is a key test of robustness in a domain-heterogeneous setting, revealing the limitations of both isolated training and standard aggregation, as detailed in Table III .
Table III(a) shows that although isolated training yields rich local models for domains A and C, their cross-domain transfer remains poor.
For instance, Model A drops to an NDS of 0.15 on domain E, indicating that strong own-domain performance does not necessarily translate into general cross-domain knowledge.
This underscores that the benchmark captures meaningful domain heterogeneity rather than only differences in local dataset size.

表三(a)显示,虽然孤立的培训为领域A和C提供了丰富的当地模式,但它们的跨领域转移仍然很差。
例如,模型A在域E上降至0.15的NDS,表明强大的自有域性能并不一定会转化为一般的跨域知识.
这突出表明,基准捕捉到有意义的域异质性,而不仅仅是局部数据集大小的差异.

blocks.en: Conversely, global aggregation with FedAvg, FedDyn, or PCGrad, as shown in Table II , sacrifices local performance on the richer domains A, B, and C, while maintaining stable but limited cross-domain performance. Because globalization forces all clients to share a single global model, a cross-domain evaluation matrix for these methods yields identical rows for every client, indicating stable yet consistently suboptimal generalization across all domains.
blocks.zh: 反之,如表二所显示的,与FedAvg、FedDyn或PCGrad的全球聚合牺牲了较富裕领域A、B和C的当地业绩,同时保持了稳定但有限的跨领域业绩。 由于全球化迫使所有客户共享一个单一的全球模式,对这些方法的跨领域评价矩阵对每个客户产生相同的一行数据,表明在所有领域稳定但始终不够理想的概括。

blocks.en:
Personalized federated methods aim to mitigate this trade-off by retaining client-specific components while still benefiting from collaborative training.
As shown in Table III(b) , FedSelect improves cross-domain transfer on average over isolated training, confirming that personalized models can still benefit from shared knowledge across clients.
blocks.zh:
个性化的联邦方法旨在减少这种取舍,保留特定客户的组成部分,同时仍受益于协作培训。
如表三(b)所显示,联邦统计局选择的跨域转移平均比孤立培训有所改善,确认个性化模式仍可从客户共享知识中受益。

blocks.en:
Compared with FedSelect, Table III(c) shows that FedCKA, which aggregates only layers with high representational similarity, boosts not only cross-domain performance but also own-domain performance (shown on the diagonal), surpassing all federated methods previously evaluated in Table II .
It is the only federated method where all five clients improve over training only on their own local datasets, and the cross-domain transfer achieves the highest average off-diagonal NDS.
This suggests that FedCKA enables beneficial knowledge transfer across clients while preserving domain-specific representations through personalization.
blocks.zh:
与FedSelect相比,表三(c)显示,FedCKA只汇总了具有高代表性相似性的地层,它不仅提升了跨域性能,而且提升了自有地域性能(在对角上显示),超过了之前在表二中评价过的所有联邦方法.
这是唯一的联邦方法,所有5个客户只在自己的本地数据集上改进培训,跨域传输实现最高的对角NDS平均.
这表明FedCKA能够使客户之间有益地进行知识转让,同时通过个性化保留特定领域的表述.

blocks.en: V-C Masking Strategy Ablation
blocks.zh: V-C 遮盖战略

blocks.en:
Both proposed personalization strategies, detailed in Section III-D , depend on either a personalization ratio ( ρ \rho ) or a similarity threshold ( τ \tau ). At the upper bound ( ρ = 1 \rho=1 or τ = 1 \tau=1 ), the models are entirely personalized (except those with mathematically perfect representational alignment), reducing to the “Own Domain Only” baseline in Table II ; at the lower bound ( ρ = 0 \rho=0 or τ = 0 \tau=0 ), the system defaults to FedAvg aggregation. Table IV summarizes the impact of varying these parameters.
Although thresholding is monotonic for a fixed set of CKA scores, each τ \tau induces a different training trajectory and permits later layer re-integration, so the personalization ratio need not vary monotonically with τ \tau .
The ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 final personalization target is additionally used as an ablation reference to compare the fixed personalization ratio used by FedSelect and FedMC.
For other detectors or applications, the masking hyperparameter can be selected according to the desired trade-off between global alignment and client-specific adaptation. A small set of values spanning this range can first be evaluated, after which the search can be refined toward the better-performing region.
The resulting masks remain stable across repeated runs and consistently isolate the same structural components, suggesting that FedCKA reliably targets domain-sensitive layers rather than collapsing into arbitrary or fully local personalization.
blocks.zh:
第三节至D节详细介绍的这两项拟议个性化战略都取决于个性化比率或相似阈值。 在上界(^ 1\rho=1或τ 1\tau=1),模型完全个性化(数学上完美的代表对接除外),降低到表二中的"Own Domain Only"基线;在下界(^ 0\rho=0或τ 0\tau=0),系统默认为FedAvg聚合. 表四总结了不同参数的影响。
虽然阈值对于一组固定的 CKA 分数来说是单调的,但每个\tau 诱导不同的训练轨迹,并允许后层重新整合,因此个性化比不需要与\tau 单调相去.
^ = 0.40\rho=0.40 最终个性化目标被额外用作去除参考,以比较FedSelect和FedMC使用的固定个性化比率.
对于其他探测器或应用,可以按照全球对接和针对客户的适应之间所期望的取舍来选择遮掩超参数. 首先可以评价跨越这一范围的一套小数值,然后可以将搜索精细化到业绩较好的区域。
由此产生的口罩在反复运行期间保持稳定,并始终孤立同一结构组件,这表明FedCKA可靠地瞄准了域敏感层,而不是崩溃成任意或完全本地的个性化.

blocks.en: TABLE IV : FedCKA ablations for percentage- and threshold-based masking in Eqs. 5 and 6 , reporting average NDS and final client personalization ratio. The two masking strategies are mutually exclusive in these experiments: percentage-based masking uses ρ \rho , while threshold-based masking uses τ \tau .
blocks.zh: 表四:FedCKA在Eqs. 5和6中基于百分率和阈值的遮盖法,报告平均NDS和最终客户个性化比率。 这两种口罩策略在这些实验中是相互排斥的:以百分比为基础的口罩使用 $\rho,而以阈值为基础的口罩使用 \tau.

blocks.en: V-D Communication and Computation Footprint
blocks.zh: V-D 通讯和计算脚印

blocks.en:
To analyze the trade-off between parameter sharing and local specialization, we estimate client-to-server upload payloads based on the average fraction of shared parameters. We model mask metadata as bit-packed binary masks: layer-level for FedBN, FedRep, and FedCKA, and parameter-level for FedMC and FedSelect.
This first-order estimate excludes protocol overhead, latency, compression, optimizer states, and server-to-client broadcasts.
blocks.zh:
为了分析参数共享与本地专业化之间的取舍,我们根据共享参数的平均分量估算客户端到服务器上传的有效载荷. 我们把元数据模拟为位包二进制口罩:FedBN、FedRep和FedCKA的层层;FedMC和FedSelect的参数层。
这一一等级估计不包括协议的间接费用,延迟,压缩,优化状态,以及服务器对客户端的广播.

blocks.en: TABLE V : Cumulative client-to-server upload over 40 40 federated rounds with 5 5 clients and a 125 125 MB base model. Mask metadata is reported per active masking round across all clients; total payload is cumulative over training. Avg. pers. is the client- and round-averaged fraction withheld from aggregation; thus, the 40 % 40\% target used by FedSelect and FedMC corresponds to 20 % 20\% on average. Raw-data centralization is included for reference.
blocks.zh: 表格五: 累计客户端到服务器上传了40多发40个联发相轮,拥有5个客户端和125个125个MB基型. 所有客户的口罩元数据都按有效口罩圆报告;总有效载荷在培训后累积。 FedSelect和FedMC所使用的40%-40-Q目标平均相当于20%-20-Q。 包括原始数据集中化供参考。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table V , FedCKA retains an upload payload comparable to full-model aggregation, reinforcing that its primary objective is dynamic personalization rather than communication compression. By using representation similarity, FedCKA flexibly decides which layers to share and which to retain locally, allowing clients to personalize different structural subsets with negligible metadata overhead.
In contrast, parameter-level masking methods reduce the transmitted model payload more substantially in our experiments because they use higher personalized parameter fractions; at matched personalization ratios, FedCKA incurs lower masking metadata because it operates at the layer level.
blocks.zh:
如表五所显示的,FedCKA保留了一个与全模型聚合相当的上传有效载荷,强化了其主要目标是动态个性化而不是通信压缩. 通过使用代表相似性,FedCKA灵活地决定了要共享的分层和要保留的地方分层,使客户能够将元数据间接费用可忽略不计的不同结构子集个性化.
相比之下,参数级掩蔽方法在我们的实验中更大幅度地减少了传输的模型有效载荷,因为它们使用了更高的个性化参数分数;在相匹配的个性化比下,FedCKA产生更低的遮掩元数据,因为它在层层中运行.

blocks.en: The additional computational cost of FedCKA comes from the client-side forward passes required to compute layer-wise CKA similarities. In our setup, this adds approximately 14,000 14{,}000 seconds of computation over the full training procedure, corresponding to 2.7 % 2.7\% of the total training time, with a peak VRAM usage of 6 GB during the CKA computation.
blocks.zh: FedCKA的额外计算费用来自计算出层相近的CKA所需的客户端前方通行证. 在我们的设置中,这比整个培训程序增加了大约14 000 14{,}000秒的计算,相当于总培训时间的2.7%-%,在计算CKA时,最高的VRAM使用为6GB.

blocks.en: V-E Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: V-E 强力分析

blocks.en: To assess run-to-run variability, we repeat the main non-federated and personalized federated experiments three times. Table VI reports the mean and standard deviation across these runs. FedCKA achieves an average NDS of 0.635 ± 0.008 0.635\pm 0.008 and CAP of 0.810 ± 0.014 0.810\pm 0.014 , remaining the strongest personalized federated method across the repeated experiments. Although some variation is present between runs, the observed performance margin over the competing personalized methods is substantially larger than the corresponding run-to-run standard deviations. These results indicate that FedCKA’s performance gains are not attributable to a single favorable training run.
blocks.zh: 为了评估跑到跑的变异性,我们重复了三次主要的不联邦化和个性化的联邦实验. 表六报告各行各业的平均偏差和标准偏差。 FedCKA的平均NDS为0.635±0.008 0.635\pm 0.008和CAP为0.810±0.014 0.810\pm 0.014,仍然是反复试验中最强的个性化结合方法. 虽然运行之间存在一些差异,但观察到的相对于竞合个性化方法的性能差值大大大于相应的运行中标准差值. 这些结果表明,FedCKA的绩效收益不能归因于一次有利的培训。

blocks.en: TABLE VI : Comparison of non-federated baselines and personalized federated learning methods. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three runs.
blocks.zh: 表六: 国家 非联邦化基线与个性化联合学习方法比较. 报告结果为三次运行的平均±\pm标准差。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate the robustness of the CKA-based masking decisions to the number of local samples used to estimate representation similarity. Across three independent runs, using 10 10 randomly sampled inputs produced the same layer-selection decisions as using 100 100 samples. We therefore use 10 10 samples throughout the experiments. Moreover, because masking decisions are re-evaluated every round, layers erroneously personalized by noisy CKA estimates can revert to global aggregation for the main method. This choice is specific to the evaluated dataset and detector and should not be interpreted as a universally optimal sample count.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估了基于CKA的掩盖决定对用于估计代表性相似性的地方样本数量是否有力。 在三个独立运行中,使用10个随机抽样投入,产生了与使用100个样本相同的层层选择决定。 因此,我们在整个实验中使用了10个样本。 此外,由于掩盖决定每轮都重新评价,被吵闹的CKA估计错误地个性化的分层可以恢复到主要方法的全球汇总. 这一选择是专门针对所评价的数据集和探测器的,不应被解释为普遍最佳的样本数.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The results on this problem-specific benchmark indicate that, for federated, data-heterogeneous 3D object detection, the global aggregation methods underperform relative to certain personalization methods.
Although manually chosen static layer personalization provides a baseline improvement over FedAvg, directly inferring personalization masks from the client models further boosts performance.
Compared with magnitude- or gradient-based personalization, the results suggest that representation similarity is a stronger criterion for selecting personalized layer or parameter subsets, improving both out-of-domain and smaller-domain performance.
blocks.zh:
这个针对特定问题的基准的结果表明,对于联邦式,数据异质的3D对象检测,全球汇总方法相对于某些个性化方法的表现不佳.
尽管人工选择的静态层个性化比FedAvg提供了基线改进,但直接从客户端模型中推断出个性化口罩会进一步提高性能.
与量级或梯度个性化相比,结果显示,代表性相似性是选择个性化地层或参数子集的更强标准,既提高了域外性能,也提高了域外性能.

blocks.en: FedCKA reduces the need to hand-pick specific layer types or impose fixed personalization ratios, since the masking decision is instead based on measured representational similarity. Furthermore, FedCKA does not assume that same-index parameters serve the same function across clients, since it compares layer activations rather than parameter-space differences.
blocks.zh: FedCKA减少了手取特定地层类型或规定固定个性化比率的必要性,因为遮掩决定的取而代之的是衡量代表的相似性. 此外,FedCKA不认为同一索引参数在客户之间具有相同的功能,因为它比较了层活化而不是参数-空间差异.

blocks.en:
Inspection of the learned masks suggests the architectural sources of domain sensitivity. Normalization layers are frequently personalized, reflecting their sensitivity to domain-specific feature scaling driven by weather, illumination, and geography. Similarly, personalization in deeper backbone, neck, and attention layers indicates that intermediate cross-modal representations, particularly the fusion weights of camera and LiDAR inputs, can be domain-sensitive.
The task head remains largely shared, which may help preserve knowledge of classes absent from specific local domains and suggests that object-level prediction semantics are transferable, while the internal representations may adjust due to various shifts.
This indicates that FedCKA does not create independent local models but instead preserves a common detection-task structure.
blocks.zh:
对所学口罩的检查表明域敏感度的建筑来源. 正常化层常被个性化,反映其对受天气,发光和地理学所驱动的域特有特征缩放的敏感性. 同样地,在更深的骨干,颈部,和注意力层中的个性化表明中间跨模式的表示,特别是相机和LiDAR输入的聚变分量,可以是域敏感.
任务负责人基本上仍然共享,这可能有助于保存特定局部领域所没有的类的知识,并表明对象级预测语义是可以被转移的,而内部表述则会因各种转变而进行调整.
这表明FedCKA并不创建独立的本地模型,而是保留了共同的检测任务结构.

blocks.en: VII Limitations
blocks.zh: 七. 限制

blocks.en: The primary limitation of this study is that the evaluation is restricted to a single detector, dataset, and domain split. The domain split is also highly imbalanced, meaning that the observed gains for smaller domains may depend on the specific scene distribution and validation composition.
blocks.zh: 本研究的主要局限在于评价仅限于单个探测器,数据集和域分. 域分化也高度不平衡,这意味着所观察到的较小域的增益可能取决于具体的场景分布和验证组成.

blocks.en: A second limitation is that the framework assumes supervised local training, which requires the availability of reliable client-side labels or a labeling pipeline. This assumption is restrictive because newly collected IV data does not naturally include high-quality 3D bounding boxes. Although offline autolabelling on idle vehicles could provide pseudo-labels, this work does not evaluate how pseudo-label noise would affect federated training.
blocks.zh: 第二个限制是,框架假定有监督的地方培训,这需要提供可靠的客户端标签或标签管道。 这个假设是限制性的,因为新收集的IV数据自然不包括高质量的3D边框. 虽然在闲置车辆上离线自动贴标签可以提供伪标签,但这项工作并不评价伪标签噪声会如何影响联邦培训.

blocks.en:
Another limitation is that although the CKA computation is relatively lightweight compared to model training, it still incurs additional computational costs for the client. It also requires flattening intermediate representations into two-dimensional matrices, which may simplify the original positional information.
Although this simplification potentially limits the captured positional dependencies, our results indicate that the flattened representations remain effective for layer-wise similarity assessment in the evaluated setting.
blocks.zh:
另一个限制是,虽然与模型培训相比,CKA的计算相对轻而易举,但仍会给客户带来额外的计算成本. 它还需要将中间表示平整为二维矩阵,这可以简化原始位置信息.
虽然这种简化可能限制所捕捉到的职位依赖性,但我们的结果表明,平分的表述方式对于评价环境中的分层相似性评估依然有效。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 八. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
This work studied federated learning for data-heterogeneous 3D object detection under shifts in weather, time, and location, showing that adaptive partial personalization can outperform a single consensus model on this benchmark.
The findings suggest that representation similarity is a useful criterion for balancing this globalization and local adaptation. For real-world robotic perception in IV deployment, cross-domain robustness and local domain adaptation are both vital, and these findings may help clarify which model layers are best suited for local adaptation.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究了在天气、时间和位置变化下对数据异质三维物体探测的联邦学习,表明适应性局部个性化能够超过这个基准的单一共识模型。
调查结果表明,代表性相似性是平衡这一全球化和地方适应的有用标准。 对于IV部署中真实世界的机器人感知,跨域稳健性和地域适应性都至关重要,这些结论可能有助于澄清哪些模型层最适合于地地地适应.

blocks.en: Future work should evaluate whether the observed benefits hold across different detectors, datasets, domain definitions, and types of heterogeneity. Methodologically, FedCKA could be extended with adaptive thresholds, temporally smoothed masks, unsupervised domain clustering based on CKA scores, and further analysis of mask stability across domain batches and batch sizes. Furthermore, a separate direction is to evaluate whether masking reduces global drift, and whether FedCKA remains effective under pseudo-labeled local training from offline autolabelling pipelines.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应评估观察到的好处是否涉及不同的探测器、数据集、域定义和异性类型。 从方法上讲,FedCKA可以以适应性阈值,时间平滑口罩,基于CKA分数的无监督域组,以及跨域分批和分批大小对口罩稳定性的进一步分析来延长. 此外,另一个方向是评估遮掩是否减少全球漂移,以及联邦边境保护局是否通过离线自动标签管道的伪标签本地培训依然有效。

blocks.en:
Finally, FedCKA does not, by itself, provide formal privacy guarantees. Combining CKA-guided masking with differential privacy is therefore an important direction for privacy-preserving deployment.
Overall, this work shows that representation similarity can provide a principled and empirically effective basis for deciding what should remain shared and what should become client-specific in federated 3D-OD.
blocks.zh:
最后,FedCKA本身并不提供正式的隐私保障。 因此,将CKA制导口罩与不同的隐私相结合,是保护隐私部署的重要方向.
总体而言,这项工作表明,代表性的相似性可以提供一个有原则和经验上有效的依据,用以决定在3D-OD联合组织中应共享哪些内容以及哪些内容应成为针对客户的。
